//: The Path 21 ledger. Each entry is a spec written by hand (path, script, subject, family, seed,
width, height, cap, theme, use, decorative, twin, underText.region/token/large) plus a record
the scene script rewrites when it renders (blender, sha256, bytes, tokens, underText.lumMin/lumMax).
Tools/blender-art/validate-art.mjs checks the record against the tree. Raise a cap only with a
capWhy in the same commit. See Tools/blender-art/README.md.
A derived entry (one with "sources", such as the icon sprite) is assembled by a Node script from other entries: it has no seed and no blender of its own. See build-sprite.mjs.

extraColors.why: the fraction tile's shaded part: ink-paper has no warm mid-tone, and white label text needs it dark enough for 4.5:1 while --card beside it needs 3:1 in greyscale
a positive algebra tile: a pale green, so positive and negative differ in luminance and not only in hue; ink-paper has no green
pattern blocks' conventional yellow hexagon, which teachers name by colour
pattern blocks' conventional tan thin rhombus
pattern blocks' conventional orange square
pattern blocks' conventional green triangle
